rows.explanation: Final q'' = c0 + cd*abs(v)*v: gravity (-9.81) plus quadratic aerodynamic drag per unit mass (cd≈-0.35 1/m). Baseline v**2 cannot change sign with velocity; replacing with abs(v)*v drops held NRMSE to ~1e-9 and BIC from -344 to -788. Linear q,v terms fitted ~1e-7 (zero) so dropped for parsimony.

Quadratic drag with shared coefficient: x''=-k|v|vx, y''=-g-k|v|vy. Fitted k~0.06 on both axes, g~9.81. Held NRMSE improves ~100% over baseline, BIC much lower, residuals drop from 1e-3 structured to 1e-8 noise.

note: Baseline-first verification of the audit fix (finding 1): 1 live run per mode with baseline residuals attached up front. Not a gate (gates need >=3/5).
